violation_type.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food (26 TAC §746.3317(10))
violation_type.short_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food
violation_type.typical_finding: Two bottles of cleaning chemicals were observed to be stored next to boxed of snack crackers and a jar of jelly

finding_variants.text: Two bottles of cleaning chemicals were observed to be stored next to boxed of snack crackers and a jar of jelly

A spray bottle labed "sanitizer" and a bottle of hand sanitizer was observed to be stored near containers of animal crackers, goldfish and veggie straws.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection. The bottles of sanitizer was removed and stored on a separate shelf

During a walk-through of the childcare facility, snacks were observed stored next to cleaning supplies in a 2-year-old classroom. The snacks were immediately removed when addressed, bringing the facility into compliance.
Chemicals were observed on the shelf with the dishes and the food.
Toxic Chemicals were being stored near the food served to children.
During the inspection, I observed cleaning supplies (bleach and spray)s on the food preparation table. The director removed supplies during the inspection.

Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food: In the kitchen counter top there were cleaning supplies were food is prepped. Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food: In the bathroom of Classroom A were crackers and goldfish stored with cleaning products and pet odor removal. This was put into compliance when the cleaning products were removed from the shelf where the food was being stored.
